Name: More Transmutations
Author: Mammutor
Description:
"More Transmutations" is a mod designed to enhance the crafting experience in Stardew Valley by adjusting the transmutation recipes for a more convenient gameplay. With this mod, players will find that the process of reverse transmuting bars feels more intuitive and rewarding, reflecting a more balanced conversion rate.

The transmutation recipes have been created to provide a balanced conversion rate, ensuring that players feel a sense of accomplishment while still maintaining a fair progression curve:

[b]2[/b] Iron Bars to [b]3[/b] Copper Bars  (Mining Level 4)
[b]2[/b] Gold Bars to [b]3[/b] Iron Bars (Mining Level 7)

Default Settings, but you can change how many Gold Bars and Iridium Bars are needed in the Generic Mod Config Menu:
1 Iridium Bars to 4 Gold Bars (Mining Level 9) 
1 Radioactive to 3 Iridium Bars (Mining Level 9)

And its [b]1.6 Compatible[/b]

Installation Instructions:
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have the latest version of Stardew Valley installed on your device.
[*]Download the "More Transmutations" mod files from the provided link.
[*]Extract the mod folder "[CP] More Transmutations" into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[*]Start a new game or load an existing save file with high enough Mining Level to experience the balanced transmutation recipes.
[/list]Note: This mod aims to enhance the gameplay experience in Stardew Valley by adjusting the transmutation recipes for a more balanced progression curve. Your feedback is valuable in refining and improving the mod further. Enjoy your enriched crafting journey with "More Transmutations"!
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, both host and client need to install this mod, otherwise only the player who installed the mod can use the crafting recipes.
[*]You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ mod with at least version 1.14.0 for this mod to work.
[/list]
Configuration:
[list]
[*]EnableIridiumTransmutations : "true" or "false" | default to "true"
[/list]﻿Set this to "false" if you want to disable the Iridium Bar transmutations which means you will not be able to transmute Gold Bars to Iridium Bar, and Iridium Bar to Gold Bars.

[list]
[*]EnableRadioactiveTransmutations : "true" or "false" | default to "true"
[/list]﻿Set this to "false" if you want to disable the Radioactive Bar transmutations which means you will not be able to transmute Iridium Bars to Radioactive Bar, and Radioactive Bar to Iridium Bars.

[list]
[*]GoldBarRequiredForIridium : [i]2, 3, 4, 5[/i] | default to "4"
[*]IridiumBarRequiredForRadioactive : [i]2, 3, 4, 5[/i] | default to "3"
[/list]
Supported Translations:
[list]
[*]English
[/list]
